playpause.note: Cleanly rendered, fits the biomech theme well.

vol.note: The interaction script dragged the knob, but the dimple indicator is in the exact same 1:30 position in both the before and after frames. The dial did not rotate.

seek.note: The native CSS grey slider thumb and blue-grey fill are clearly visible beneath/behind the custom purple sinew sprite, breaking the illusion.

shuffle.note: Fantastic characterful bone switch, works beautifully.

notes: Aesthetically, this is a phenomenal execution of the Giger prompt. The materials feel wet, oppressive, and appropriately bone-like.
The shuffle bone switch is a standout piece of design.
Unfortunately, the dead volume knob and the visible CSS elements on the seek slider force a hard fail.
improve: Ensure the volume knob sprite is properly separated and capable of rotating to reflect its value.
Hide or properly size the native CSS thumb and track on the seek slider so the custom sinew sprite completely replaces them without ghosting.
